description: This file generates a payment period report based on invoice dates, including functions for data retrieval, filtering, and validation within the ERPNext accounting system.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to generate the report data based on filters.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates the filter combinations to prevent invalid queries.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns for the report based on filters.

methods.name: get_conditions
methods.description: Builds SQL conditions dynamically based on filters.

methods.name: get_entries
methods.description: Fetches GL entries from the database matching the filters.

methods.name: get_invoice_posting_date_map
methods.description: Retrieves invoice posting and due dates for mapping.
